treemmm: Tree-Based Marketing Mix Modeling with SHAP Attribution

Source: R/treemmm-package.R
treemmm-package.Rd

Tree-based MMM using gradient-boosted trees (LightGBM, XGBoost) paired with SHAP attribution. R port of the Python TreeMMM package (https://github.com/jamesyoung93/treemmm).

Main entry points

  • run_config() and column_spec() to describe a panel and pipeline.

  • treemmm_run() to execute the pipeline end-to-end.

  • generate_pharma_dataset() and siblings to produce the synthetic DGPs.

Status

Version 0.2.1.9000 is Phase 1 (scaffold). Functions are present as stubs that throw Not yet implemented. See ROADMAP.md for the seven-phase plan.
